definition: BP stands for blood pressure, the force of blood against artery walls. In this study context, it is a health outcome tracked to see whether an intervention changes patients’ beliefs, adherence, and hypertension control.

reasons: The definition states that BP is “the force of blood against artery walls,” but the provided packet only uses BP as “blood pressure (BP)” and reports systolic BP; it does not describe BP as a force against artery walls.

The rest of the definition (that, in the study context, BP is a health outcome tracked to see whether an intervention changes beliefs, adherence, and hypertension control) is broadly consistent with the packet’s aim to explore effects on illness perceptions, medication beliefs, medication adherence, and BP, but the unsupported “force” phrasing prevents the definition from being fully supported.
The packet supports BP as an abbreviation for blood pressure in the study, but it does not support the added general definition “the force of blood against artery walls.”
